'''Glider-sails''' were multipurpose equipment. Six of them were carried aboard the [[Explorer (space boat)|''Explorer'']]. They could be used for wind sailing or [[Parachute/Legends|parachuting]].<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>
